items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I believe it was a brother called Walter Donovan... He was playing trumpet. That band been rubble for so long.

ctx.x: And who was the trumpet player?

I'm trying to think of him now. Who was. I'm trying to think of a trumpet player. I believe it was a brother called Walter Donovan. He's dead now. He was playing what, trumpet or trombone? Trumpet. He was playing trumpet. That band been rubble for so long.
Quite long. Because I was a brother on bass, I was drum.
